llm_router.note: Default inference is LIVE: this site publishes a publisher-funded Otari default (model alibaba/qwen3.8-flash), so the network runs with no visitor key — the spec §6 default path. The publisher key is a bounded, revocable registrant-credit key generated into the deployed bundle at deploy time; a purely static site has no server side to hold it, and it is never committed to the public repository. Visitors may override with their own key in Settings (BYOK): that key stays in their browser, sent only to the router they chose — never to this site or any peer site. A clearly-labelled demo mode with local mock specialists remains available in Settings, and the visit to Deadline Desk returns live board data in every mode.

peer_policy.note: No third-party origin is contacted without a friendly consent card naming the destination and purpose. Private context (sly_data) is deny-by-default: no field is allowed to pass to a peer network.
